title: Auth, onboarding and billing runtime proof control map

controls.name: Exact current main SHA
controls.objective: Prevent stale or substituted release evidence.

controls.name: Protected read-only execution
controls.objective: Limit execution authority and prevent production mutation.

controls.name: Onboarding schema and atomic activation
controls.objective: Prove the target database supports the canonical onboarding contract.

controls.name: Completed onboarding
controls.objective: Observe real completed organization onboarding rather than an operator assertion.

controls.name: Active canonical subscription
controls.objective: Prove the organization has an active or trialing subscription with consistent plan data.

controls.name: Processed Stripe correlation
controls.objective: Reject failed, stale or cross-tenant webhook evidence.

controls.name: Chained audit persistence
controls.objective: Prove the accepted webhook and subscription synchronization are present in the canonical SHA-256 audit chain.

controls.name: Artifact minimization and integrity
controls.objective: Retain useful evidence without credentials, connection strings, raw rows or full identifiers.

controls.name: Fail-closed decision
controls.objective: Prevent partial runtime observations from being promoted as complete evidence.

truthBoundary: This control map covers the selected organization, target environment, workflow execution time and exact release SHA only. It does not establish universal tenant correctness, payment settlement, legal compliance or certification.
